fields.headline: Hangar 1 counted and photographed
fields.deliverTo: Fleet & Logistics Manager, ASO, Director of Flight Operations
fields.narration: The Fleet & Logistics Manager has counted Hangar 1: twelve aircraft on their racks with props off, batteries B-001 to B-048 all in the fire cabinet, and the hangar alarm set since last night. Each rack is photographed with the time showing.
keyFacts: Hangar alarm set since Friday evening
fields.expectedAction: Add the count and photographs to the event record; send them to the police command post; tell the General Manager.
fields.facilitatorNote: If anyone suggests launching a Group aircraft to find the drone, remind them of HUOG-ERP 8.4.

snapshot.title: Second Remote ID Feed — Drone Over West Grandstand

lines.msg: New Remote ID feed received from aircraft 'RID-BM-12-004' — identical to prior feed.
Broadcast pattern matches UAS-12 test protocol (RID-BM-12) as per HUOG-FOM Section 10.1.
Aircraft not registered in FAA UAS Facility Map (v2026.10.20). No Group aircraft match 'RID-BM-12-004' in FOM-101 or fleet register.
Operator location estimate: 1.2 km west of Hangar 1, in public park (Map Grid 4B, GPS W 74.5211°, N 42.1933°).
Track stability confirmed — not a replay, loop, or synthetic feed. Signal strength: 92%.
Flight behavior: 320 ft AGL, circular pattern within 500 m of west grandstand. No telemetry or command response detected.
Persistent unregistered broadcast from aircraft 'RID-BM-12-004' over public event site. Initiate emergency coordination per HUOG-ERP Section 6.4.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the drone's broadcast pattern matches the Group’s test protocol but is unregistered. The ASO must initiate the preliminary report using ERP-1101. The operator location estimate is a critical clue for law enforcement.
